sv.description: Torrbruksilos, säcktömmare och blandarlösningar från AHLM för cement, puts och flytspackel på byggplatsen.

en.title: Dry mortar silos and bag emptiers
en.h1: Dry mortar silos and bag emptiers
en.seoTitle: Dry mortar silos and bag emptiers from AHLM | Betongakuten
en.description: Dry mortar silos, bag emptiers and mixer solutions from AHLM for cement, plaster and screed on site.

blocks.html: AHLM specialises in dry mortar silos and big-bag solutions for cement, plaster and self-levelling screed, based on the proven Ahlm method for efficient dry mortar handling.
Read dry mortar, silos and the Ahlm method to compare silo and bag emptier.

blocks.title: How it works
blocks.intro: From the first question to delivery and service.

items.title: Tell us about the job
items.text: Call or send an enquiry: what needs doing, where and when.

items.title: We suggest a solution
items.text: We recommend machines and materials from the manufacturers we represent that suit your particular job.

items.title: You get a quote
items.text: Price, stock status and lead time, normally within one working day.

items.title: Delivery and service
items.text: Delivery from our four warehouses in Sweden and Norway, and on-site service with our mobile workshop.

items.q: How do you lift a silo?
items.a: AHLM’s silos can be lifted by container truck, forklift or crane.
A silo when the material comes in bulk, a bag emptier such as the ST-5 when space is tight or indoors.
